summary: fractal-web adds the unmounted sidebar folders adapter: TUI-ordered folder and host-group trees, drop validation with fixed refusal copy, native fractional-key moves that never collide with dormant placements, append-only creation, lift-on-delete, and an explicit Try again that restages structural intent against fresh arrangement state, bound to the Sidebar and agent identities seen at gesture time, instead of resending the refused edit

replay.detail: Client-only change; no runtime replay change.

compatibility.detail: Client-only change using the existing arrangement.edit operations; existing folder views are not remounted.

manual.detail: No deployed installation action required; the adapter is not mounted until the kit sidebar lands.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change; collapse state stays in memory.
